title: Fourier Analysis
text: 离散或连续时间傅里叶分析，输入 1 路、输出 2 路；按 {Fundamental frequency (Hz)} 指定信号基频；{Harmonic numbers} 指定信号谐波次数、{Initial magnitude} 指定初始信号幅值、{Initial phase (rad)} 指定初始信号相位、{Buffer size} 指定缓冲区大小、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 傅里叶分析输入 scalar | vector

params.name: Fundamental frequency (Hz)
params.values: 信号基频 60 (default) | positive scalar | vector with positive values

params.name: Harmonic numbers
params.values: 信号谐波次数 [1 2] (default) | vector with elements ≥ 0

params.name: Initial magnitude
params.values: 初始信号幅值 1 (default) | vector with elements ≥ 0

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | 0 | positive scalar
